## About
Mystic Street Gulf sits at 140 Mystic Street in Arlington. We pump gas and run a full service repair shop for all makes and models, from oil changes and tune-ups to brakes, alignment and electrical work.
Our aim is complete car care at a fair price, with fast, honest, dependable service. We hold a 4.1 rating from 79 Google reviews.
Live in Belmont? Our other location, Pleasant Street Shell, is there for you.

## Services
- State inspections: Massachusetts state inspections right here on Mystic Street.
- Free diagnostics: We'll take a look and tell you what's going on before any work starts.
- Oil changes and tune-ups: Scheduled maintenance to keep your car running right.
- Alignment: Front and rear wheel alignment.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for diagnostics?
A: No. Diagnostics are free.
